q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution
Today is August 25, 2026. Q2 FY2027 for NVIDIA runs from May to July 2026. The earnings release occurred on May 20, 2026 (per the research), so this resolution likely occurs in late August 2026 or early September 2026 — **essentially imminent, within days**. The guidance has already been issued.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The question asks what **will be** NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release. The research explicitly states this guidance has already been issued: **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%** (range: $89.2B to $92.8B).

Since the earnings release and guidance already occurred on May 20, 2026, and we are now on August 25, 2026, this is asking for a value that has already been determined. The guidance issued was $91.0B with a ±2% range.

The most likely outcome is the midpoint of **$91.0 billion**, as that is the central guidance that was already communicated.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- If the question resolves to a different interpretation (e.g., actual Q2 revenue rather than forward guidance)
- If there was a correction or revised guidance issued after May 20, 2026 (no such revision is mentioned in the research)
- Misinterpretation of which quarter's guidance is being referenced

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- If the question intends to ask about actual Q2 FY2027 revenue results (not guidance), analysts expect it could exceed guidance — Jefferies forecasts $95B for Q2 FY2027
- If there was a revised guidance upward issued after May 20, 2026 (not mentioned in research)
- The sequential growth from Q1 ($81.6B) of 20% would suggest potential for growth toward $97.9B

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research provides the actual issued guidance: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**, which translates to a range of $89.2B to $92.8B. Wall Street's average estimate is $91.9B (within the guided range). Jefferies' bullish forecast is $95B. Q1 FY2027 actual was $81.6B.

Given the guidance is already publicly available at $91.0B with a ±2% range, and assuming the question is asking for the guidance value (not actual results, which haven't occurred yet), the answer should cluster tightly around $91.0B.

---

## Probability Distribution

The guidance has been formally issued at **$91.0 billion ± 2%**. The range given in the question (99.5B to 115.5B) is notably *higher* than the already-issued guidance, suggesting either:
1. The question expects actual results (not guidance), which could be higher
2. There's upside potential if guidance is revised

However, based on the explicit research stating the guidance was $91.0B issued on May 20, 2026, I should weight heavily toward the midpoint of $91.0B.

The range provided (99.5B-115.5B) being significantly above current guidance suggests some expectation of upside, but the research shows conservative guidance ($91.0B) with Jefferies as the bull case at $95B for Q2.

Accounting for:
- The formal guidance of $91.0B already issued (highest weight)
- Analyst consensus at $91.9B 
- Jefferies bull case at $95B
- Possibility of actual results beating guidance
- The wide range provided suggesting uncertainty or upside potential

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, issued on May 20, 2026, is **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%** [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027). This implies a range with a ceiling near $92.8 billion and a floor near $89.2 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). This guidance assumes no data center compute revenue from China [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).

Wall Street's average analyst estimate for Q2 FY2027 revenue is $91.9 billion, placing it within NVIDIA's guided range [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). Jefferies, however, forecasts NVIDIA to post $95 billion in revenue for Q2 FY2027, with Q3 FY2027 revenue reaching $108 billion [finance.yahoo.com](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/1-veteran-analyst-sees-nvidia-115749161.html). NVIDIA's Q1 FY2027 revenue was $81.6 billion, up 20% sequentially [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/). The midpoint of the Q2 guidance implies revenue close to doubling year-over-year compared to $46.7 billion in the year-ago quarter [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).
